notes.title: Lefsa Plushie - Available Now!
notes.notes:
The Lefsa Plushie is live!

You can find her at this link here: https://www.makeship.com/products/lefsa-plush

Thank you so much to Makeship for reaching out to create this cool plush! It's Lefsa Meep -er- Dellia from the game Franzen! She's here! She's real!

This is an awesome opportunity to help me out and have some cool merch for a game very dear to me.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44554932/28462b397913064ffb45ad2f9c86b1b7dd058ed4.png[/img]

It's Lefsa, the grub-wife from Franzen! Oh god! She's real! This six legged cretin will watch you all day and night, so don't do anything suspicious! Squeeze her, pet her, use her as a blunt weapon, tell her your secrets! Place her anywhere: on a shelf, inside a pipe, inside a brass instrument, inside a pipe, or inside a pipe! Any place dark, cramped, or damp. It's where the beast is most comfortable.

Lefsa has a heart of gold, so give her lots of hugs and reward her good deeds. Above all else, take good care of her.

notes.title: Please Back up your save data for tomorrow's update!
notes.notes:
Gonna be honest lads, I have no idea if uploading an updated build will screw with save data. Just in case it does, back up your files!

Thank you all for playing, it means the world. I'm glad everyone is enjoying my project!

I'd also like to thank my homie Osiol for his extensive playtesting and script editing, Franzen would be no where near it's current quality without that help.

Tomorrow's update will fix a softlock, and some general improvements all around.
